title: (RHBA-2011:0601) s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary:
An updated s390utils package that fixes multiple bugs and adds several
enhancements is now available.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously-released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to
use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/docs/DOC-11259
portal_description:
The s390utils package contains utilities related to Linux for the IBM System z
architecture. 

These updated s390utils packages include numerous bug fixes and enhancements.
Space precludes documenting all of these changes in this advisory. Users are
directed to the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6.1 Technical Notes for information on
the most significant of these changes:

https://docs.redhat.com/docs/en-US/Red_Hat_Enterprise_Linux/6/html/6.1_Technical_Notes/index.html

All s390utils users are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which
provide numerous bug fixes and enhancements.

IBM System z users should install this updated package which addresses these
issues and adds these enhancements.
